name: Otome Renshin Prister
source:
In a nameless world where there is a ring of light in the sky and a giant tower on the ground, there exists mysterious living things called ‘Pristers’ which are alter-egos for the girls they follow. There’s a big event to determine the ‘magic girl’ and each of the 3 kingdoms send their own team to compete for the title.

[From [url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
translation:
在一个无名世界里，天空悬着一道光环，大地耸立着一座巨塔。那里存在着名为“普莉斯特”的神秘生物，它们是所跟随少女的分身。为了选出“魔法少女”，一场盛大赛事即将举行，3个王国分别派出自己的队伍争夺称号。

[摘自[url=https://omochikaeri.wordpress.com/2010/01/01/january-2010-eroge-releases/]Hau~ Omochikaeri![/url]]
